messages.content: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure for air, given its temperature is 298K and volume is 10 m^3.

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

function.name: calculate_discounted_cash_flow
function.description: Calculate the discounted cash flow of a bond for a given annual coupon payment, time frame and discount rate.

coupon_payment.description: The annual coupon payment. This is a float type value.

period.description: The time frame in years for which coupon payment is made.

discount_rate.description: The discount rate. This is a float type value.

face_value.description: The face value of the bond, default is $1000.

message.reasoning_content: The user wants to calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure for air, given temperature 298K and volume 10 m^3. The function calc_heat_capacity requires parameters: temp (integer), volume (integer), and optionally gas (string, default is air). The user specified air, so we can use the default or explicitly set gas to "air". The required parameters are temp and volume. So we need to call calc_heat_capacity with temp=298, volume=10, gas="air". Let's do that.
